title: URAAN-E-AI 2026
subtitle: Pakistan's Digital Flight
summary: Pakistan's Digital Flight – National IT & Artificial Intelligence Seminar 2026. A national gathering of students, educators, technology professionals, corporate representatives, entrepreneurs, and emerging innovators.
description:
URAAN-E-AI 2026 is a national IT and Artificial Intelligence seminar bringing together students, educators, technology professionals, corporate representatives, entrepreneurs, and emerging innovators to explore how AI is reshaping Pakistan's economy, workforce, education, and future.

The event will feature expert discussions and a forward-looking panel exploring what an AI-first economy means for businesses and people, whether Pakistani organizations are ready for AI adoption, the skills required for the next generation, and how Pakistan can use AI to accelerate innovation and development.
about: URAAN-E-AI 2026 brings together Pakistan's emerging technology community, educators, industry professionals, entrepreneurs and young innovators for a national conversation on Artificial Intelligence and the future of Pakistan's digital economy.

The event explores how AI can transform businesses, careers, education and innovation while examining the opportunities and challenges Pakistan faces as the global economy moves toward an AI-first future.
highlights: Expert discussions on Pakistan's AI-first economy

A national gathering of students, educators, professionals and innovators

The panel explores how Pakistan can prepare for an AI-first economy — from business adoption and future skills to startups, education, ethics and national development.
